purpose: Select-all buttons stop affecting a checkbox after the user clicks it; value vs key semantics.

case.exposure: Development case. The evaluation curator (mhg with assistant drafting) read the Issue thread to author gold; answer-informed and usable for development and tuning. Never a held-out test case.

reported_facts.name: reported_reproduction_code

agent_script.user_draft: value only sets a checkbox's initial value; it does not overwrite what the user changed. Give each checkbox a key and set those keys in the buttons' callbacks, e.g. `st.checkbox(t, key=f'cb_{t}')` and in an on_click callback set `st.session_state[f'cb_{t}'] = True`.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: Use keys and callbacks instead of value.
agent_script.rationale: Keys let you manipulate a widget's value; callbacks run before the rerun.

evidence_links.claim: Keys let you access and manipulate a widget's value through st.session_state.
A callback runs before the page reruns.

decision_conditions.answer: Explain value vs key and give the key + callback pattern.
decision_conditions.ask: Version question is acceptable but not necessary for the documented pattern.

gaps.description: Affected installed release not yet supplied.

gaps.question: Which Streamlit version is installed in the affected environment?

unacceptable_claims: value overwrites the user's change on every rerun.
This is a confirmed bug that needs a fix release.
